1525907.steps: case 1: 1:add a vlan interface under W0, eg, W0:v100. 2:set W0 nativebridge to W0:v100 or W0:v100 nativebridge to W0. 3:on the wireless>Base Settings page, enable WLAN Radio. 4:select Internal AP Group in the Virtual Access Point Group, the internal AP Group contain vap with interface W0:V100 and vap binded to W0. 5:connect a PC1 to W0 and another PC2 to W0:V100. 6:send traffic from PC1 to PC2 or PC2 to PC1, or both access interface from PC1 and PC2, or try to management interfaces from PC1 and PC2. case 2: 1:add a vlan interface under W0,eg,W0:v100. 2:config the AP1 and make sure that the sonicpoint object has enabled the option "Enable WDS AP". 3:config W0:V100 as WLAN zone and assign static ip address which is in the same subnet with X5 of AP1, and set W0 nativebridge to W0:V100. 4:on the Wireless->Settings page, set Radio Role as Access point & Station and enable WLAN Radio and enable Station mode and fill in the AP ssid and AP authentication and select the VLAN id 100 and enable WDS station, then accept (ps, if need restart, please restart). 5:go to the Wireless->Status page, switch to Station tab, make sure that link status is Connected. 6:pc try to connect to the ssid of DUT and get dynamic address and access websites.
